title: Calibrate physical wiring layout
description: Use 'Index Walk' pattern at slow speed to determine: which corner is LED 0, which axis the strings run along, and whether each row is serpentine. Save the discovered Layout settings as the default in src/shared/types.ts.

title: Pattern: rain / falling drops
description: Drops spawn on the top layer and fall along Z, leaving fading trails. Audio increases spawn rate.

title: Pattern: fire / flame from base
description: Heat-diffusion model rising from z=0 with cooling and color ramp. 3D variant of the classic Fire2012.

title: WLED handoff lifecycle (reclaim/release)
description: When server starts streaming, optionally pause WLED's own effects via JSON API. On stop, send a final 'release' packet and let WLED revert. Document the WLED 'live' indicator behavior we already see.

title: Pattern: 3D Conway-ish life
description: Pick a 3D life ruleset (e.g., 5766) that produces interesting steady-state activity. Render living cells with smooth alpha.

title: Frame pacing and packet retransmission strategy
description: Today we just setInterval and fire 3 UDP packets per frame. Investigate sequencing/timing on a busy WiFi: do we drop frames? Should we retransmit? Use WLED 'UDP packet retransmissions' setting?

title: Add audio capture (browser) + level/bands over WS
description: Capture from getUserMedia, run AnalyserNode FFT in the browser, send rolling level + N frequency bands to server over WS at high rate. Server merges into PatternContext.audio (and a new audio.bands array). Wire to wavySheet so it actually spikes on input.

title: Beat / onset detection
description: On top of audio bands: detect onsets (low-band energy ramp) and emit discrete beat events. Patterns can use these for explicit hits (e.g., wavySheet spike, flash plane).

title: Pattern: rotating planes
description: A plane defined by normal n(t) and offset, lighting all voxels within thickness of the plane. Rotate over time. Bonus: stack multiple planes.

title: Pattern: 3D plasma
description: Smooth volumetric noise field, hue-cycled. Good baseline for showing the 3D-ness of the cube.

title: Switch frame WS payload to binary
description: JSON of 3000 numbers per frame is wasteful. Send Uint8Array via ws binaryType='arraybuffer' on both sides. Should drop CPU/network considerably and let us push 60 fps.

title: Audio-reactive wavy sheet variants
description: Wire band-split audio into wavySheet: bass drives base displacement, mids modulate amplitude, highs add small surface noise. Make the spike radial-from-center on transients.

title: 3D mesh primitives library
description: Reusable helpers in shared/: implicit-surface marcher (sheet given f(x,y)->z), great-circle plane drawing, particle integrator with trail buffer, voxelized line/sphere drawers.

title: Persisted presets / snapshots
description: Save/load named (patternId, params, layout) snapshots to disk on the server. Quick-launch from the UI.

title: Optional DDP backend
description: DDP supports >490 LEDs cleanly with a PUSH flag and is widely supported. Add DDP as an alternative to DNRGB for benchmarking and resilience.
